physics: A close-to-strike BTC path with many minutes left can cross the boundary repeatedly. In that state, large apparent edge is often unstable trajectory energy, not terminal information; NO-side early boundary rows get the largest shrink because target-surface losses concentrate there.
rule: Shrink raw fair value toward 50 when recross hazard, long clock, near-strike geometry, and weak executable edge imply unresolved path energy. Apply the unchanged target-coverage policy to the adjusted FV.
